description: This file defines an Angular component named 'Row' used for rendering a flexible row layout with customizable alignment and distribution styles. It includes Angular decorators, styling, and template code for dynamic content rendering.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: An Angular component extending DynamicComponent, representing a flexible row layout with configurable alignment and distribution properties.

methods.name: alignment
methods.description: An input property to configure the row's item alignment, defaulting to 'stretch'.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: An input property to configure the distribution of space among items, defaulting to 'start'.

methods.name: classes
methods.description: A computed property that generates CSS classes based on theme, alignment, and distribution settings.
